assets.name: day-mac-studio-desk-perspective
assets.prompt: Use case: sketch-to-render / compositing. Image 1 is the AUTHORITATIVE CAMERA GEOMETRY: render the object into this exact projected box, with softly rounded corners. Image 2 is ONLY the object's identity/material reference; its symmetric product-shot perspective is WRONG and MUST NOT be preserved. Image 3 shows the actual desk placement and explains why this asymmetry is required. Output ONE isolated silver Apple desktop computer on a genuine alpha transparent 1536x1024 canvas. Maintain the exact bounding box and plane directions of image 1. The top recedes UP AND RIGHT. Its rear corners are at (388,194) and (1318,194); front top corners are at (218,429) and (1192,429). Front bottom is (218,830) to (1192,830), rear right bottom (1318,577). Show the RIGHT SIDE face: camera sees this object from the desk center to its right. All depth edges must point up-right as in the guide, not opposite directions. Preserve rounded aluminum block, thin dark rubber base, Apple logo mapped to the skewed top plane. Front stays level, clean and blank; no ports, text, or status LED. The guide is a construction envelope: apply the product's rounded corners while keeping its projection and plane layout. Soft neutral DAYLIGHT from upper left, polished 3D realism matching existing illustration. A small translucent contact shadow underneath. No outline strokes, no guide lines, no visible box, no flat diagram styling, no desk/background/other objects, no glow. Crucially do NOT center the top symmetrically above the front: follow the asymmetric guide exactly.
